name: Shinsei
source:
Shinsei is a very short, minimalist, non-branching visual novel created within about four hours. After much deliberation and guided by some insightful opinions I bring you this short, unpolished and very abstract piece. 

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20240421204014/https://renai.us/game/shinsei]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
《Shinsei》是一部流程极短、风格简约、没有分支的视觉小说，制作耗时约四小时。经过反复斟酌，并参考了一些富有洞见的意见，我为大家带来了这部短小、尚欠打磨而又十分抽象的作品。

（摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20240421204014/https://renai.us/game/shinsei]Ren’Ai档案库[/url]）
